assessment.summary: This conference poster abstract summarizes insecticide resistance and mechanisms in Anopheles gambiae S form from Kouilou Potash near Pointe Noire, Republic of the Congo in April 2009. While L1014F/S kdr and rdl mutations are mentioned, no extractable genotype numbers or frequencies are presented.
